# Teleport handling

`cinnabar:extension/teleport-handling@0.1.0`

Local-player MovePlayer rotations before they apply, for `handle-teleport`.

**Grants:** `camera` to run handle-teleport; this interface only defines handler types.

## Types

<a id="type-rotation"></a>

### `rotation`

Bedrock degrees: yaw turns clockwise from south; positive pitch looks down, -90 to 90.

```wit
record rotation {
    yaw: f32,
    pitch: f32,
}
```

| Member | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `yaw` | `f32` |  |
| `pitch` | `f32` |  |

<a id="type-teleport-mode"></a>

### `teleport-mode`

How the server moved the local player, as MovePlayer reports it.

```wit
enum teleport-mode {
    normal,
    reset,
    teleport,
    rotation,
    other,
}
```

| Member | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `normal` |  |  |
| `reset` |  |  |
| `teleport` |  |  |
| `rotation` |  |  |
| `other` |  |  |

<a id="type-teleport-context"></a>

### `teleport-context`

One committed MovePlayer for the local player. Only `rotation` is changeable; position,
physics and acknowledgments always follow the server.

```wit
record teleport-context {
    mode: teleport-mode,
    server: rotation,
    presented: rotation,
    rotation: rotation,
}
```

| Member | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `mode` | `teleport-mode` |  |
| `server` | `rotation` | The rotation the server sent. |
| `presented` | `rotation` | The local view immediately before this move. |
| `rotation` | `rotation` | The rotation the view takes: the server's, or an earlier handler's replacement.<br>Set it to `presented` to keep the current view. |

Types: [`rotation`](teleport-handling.md#type-rotation), [`teleport-mode`](teleport-handling.md#type-teleport-mode).

## Functions

This interface defines shared types and has no functions.
